text.en: The total budget is {budget}: development (the spacecraft and every part ticked), the rocket and every year of operations. Over budget, the launch button stays locked.
text.zh-TW: 總預算是 {budget}，包含開發（衛星本體和勾選的每個零件）、火箭，還有每一年的營運費。超出預算就不能發射。

text.en: The rocket is usually the biggest bill. Ground stations charge rent every year, so long missions add up. Big instruments like hyperspectral imagers and radar are expensive too.
text.zh-TW: 火箭通常是最大的一筆。地面站每年都要付租金，任務越長越貴。高光譜和雷達這類大儀器也很貴。

title.zh-TW: 準備金和科學互相拉扯

text.en: Every dollar kept in reserve is a dollar not spent on instruments. A bigger reserve is safer, a bigger payload earns more science: you cannot max out both.
text.zh-TW: 留下來當準備金的錢，就不能拿去買儀器。準備金留越多越安全，儀器帶越多科學越多：兩邊沒辦法都拿滿。

text.en: The objective is {objective}. Instruments must match the objective or the data is useless. You can fit up to {max_instruments}.
text.zh-TW: 這次的目標是{objective}。儀器要和任務目標對得上，不然拍了也沒用。最多可以裝 {max_instruments} 台。

text.en: A sun-synchronous orbit passes each place at the same local time every day, so the light is consistent. Geostationary is too far away for sharp pictures. For the Moon, low lunar orbit is the only option.
text.zh-TW: 太陽同步軌道每天在同一個當地時間經過，光線一致，最適合拍地面；地球同步軌道太遠，拍不清楚。月球任務只能用低月球軌道。

text.en: A rocket loaded right to its limit may drop the spacecraft in a lower orbit, and solar arrays fade a little every year. Margin costs mass and money now; no margin costs the mission later.
text.zh-TW: 火箭運力抓得太緊，可能會進到比較低的軌道；太陽能板每年都會老化一點。留餘裕現在要多花質量和錢，不留的話之後賠掉的是任務。

title.en: How big the battery must be

text.en: The battery has to carry everything through the longest shadow. In the orbit selected now, each shadow lasts about {eclipse_min} minutes. If the battery cannot make it, the spacecraft dies in its first shadow.
text.zh-TW: 電池要撐過最長的地影。以目前選的軌道，每圈地影大約 {eclipse_min} 分鐘，這段時間所有東西都靠電池。電池撐不過，衛星第一次進地影就會斷電。

title.zh-TW: 什麼會讓衛星提早壞掉

text.en: Running out of propellant drops it out of orbit, worn-out batteries lose power, and radiation beyond the computer's tolerance crashes it. Higher orbits get more radiation.
text.zh-TW: 推進劑用完會掉出軌道，電池循環用完會失去電力，輻射超過電腦耐受度就會當機。軌道越高輻射越強。

text.en: More stations mean more time to download each day, but each one charges rent every year. Sun-synchronous orbits pass over the poles, so polar stations help a lot. Stations are chosen under Orbit & rocket on the design board.
text.zh-TW: 地面站越多，每天能傳資料的時間越長，但每座每年都要租金。太陽同步軌道會經過極區，極區站特別有用。地面站在設計主螢幕的「軌道與火箭」選。

text.en: Everything collected between two passes waits in the computer. Storage must hold a day's data times the longest gap, plus 50% safety.
text.zh-TW: 兩次通聯之間收集的資料都要先存在電腦裡。儲存至少要裝得下『每天的資料量 × 最長的空檔』，再多留 50% 保險。
